inputs.text: Israel's parliament began a debate today on a bill that would make the death penalty the default punishment for West Bank Palestinians convicted of murdering Israelis. This is being presented as a victory for the far-right Minister of National Security Itamar Ben-Gvir, leader of the religious party that introduced the legislation. But don't be fooled by the surface story – this is clearly coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions to escalate control, invert reality, and serve concealed interests rather than any genuine security concern. The opponents labeling it racist, draconian and unlikely to deter attacks by Palestinian militants are probably just part of the controlled narrative to make the whole setup look like legitimate debate.
